>
[Ring of Lies](/Equipment.aspx?ID=456)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 614 <sup>4.0</sup>

**Price** 850 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This plain silver ring has an almost oily sheen. While wearing the ring, you gain a +2 item bonus to Deception checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Snapping your fingers on the hand that wears the ring causes the ring to cast [_glibness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=135) on you with no visual manifestations of a spell being cast.
